requirements.text: The server creates a Checkout Session for a price with success and cancel URLs
Webhook requests are verified against the Stripe-Signature header on the raw body, with timestamp tolerance
Each webhook event is processed once even when Stripe retries it
checkout.session.completed fulfills the order or activates the subscription
Subscription status changes update the account's billing state

evidence.name: Stripe-Signature: multiple v1, tolerance in both directions

implementations.notes: Bounded Stripe client; Checkout Session creation is not covered by a named repository test
Maps subscription status to plan access; syncing from Stripe events is the app's work
